modifications.free-move: Custom walking pose matching the Pick Up figure proportions, inspired by the walk motif.
modifications.adjust-view: Custom matching line drawing of a person shading their eyes with one hand.
modifications.visit-store: Open door adaptation with a matching person stepping toward the doorway.
modifications.enter-area: Custom person standing among a cabinet, a table, and a sofa, matching the shared line style. Cabinet shifted 1 viewBox unit left and table/sofa 1 unit right for extra clearance around the person. Table and sofa translated upward 4 units as whole objects, preserving their original proportions.
modifications.approach-fixture: Custom matching walking figure combined with shelves and products.
modifications.pick-up: Custom person holding a product above a cart, using the shopping-cart motif.

rendering: Inline SVG in project_page/index.html; 32-unit viewBox, 1.7-unit strokes, round caps/joins, currentColor. All six people use the Pick Up proportions: head radius 2.3 centered at y=6, torso from y=11 to y=20, feet at y=28; horizontal translation and arm pose vary by action.
